Package com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.config.bitcoin

Class KfeBitcoinFinalityPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.config.bitcoin.KfeBitcoinFinalityPolicy
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="bitcoin") public class KfeBitcoinFinalityPolicy extends Object
Granular Bitcoin finality policy for the deposit lifecycle.

Deposit stages: DETECTED → CONFIRMING → CREDITED → FINALIZED

Rules:

  1. Credit at creditConfirmations makes funds available, monitoring continues.
  2. Monitor until finalityConfirmations window.
  3. Reorg before credit: remove expectation, notify "deposit not confirmed".
  4. Reorg after credit: lock equivalent amount, create compensating entry.
  5. Risk-based policy by amount (not enforced here — callers evaluate cutoff).

    • requiredConfirmationsForAmount

      public int requiredConfirmationsForAmount(long amountSats, long lowSats, long highSats)
      Risk-based required confirmations by amount.

      Up to lowSats → 1 conf, between → 3 confs, above → 6 confs.

      Parameters:
      amountSats - deposit amount being evaluated
      lowSats - inclusive lower-risk amount cutoff
      highSats - inclusive medium-risk amount cutoff
      Returns:
      1, 3, or 6 confirmations based on the amount bands
